# k0rdent_organization (Data Source)

One organization, read by id.

Use it to check that the `organization_id` a `k0rdent_project` names is a real organization, and that it is `active`, before a project is created in it. `k0rdent_organizations` is where to find the id.

Like `k0rdent_project` it takes no `region` and no `project`: an organization lives on the global control-plane tier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fail the plan if the organization isn't active, instead of partway through
# the apply.
data "k0rdent_organization" "acme" {
  id = "org-acme"

  lifecycle {
    postcondition {
      condition     = self.status == "active"
      error_message = "org-acme is ${self.status}, so a project cannot be created in it."
    }
  }
}

resource "k0rdent_project" "research" {
  id              = "research"
  organization_id = data.k0rdent_organization.acme.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The organization's id. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL. String length must be at most 63.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the organization was created, as RFC 3339.
- `description` (String) Free-form text describing it, for people to read. Null for an organization created before the platform required a description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-friendly name. Null for an organization created before the platform required one.
- `self_link` (String) Platform-defined reference to this organization.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status. `active` is usable. `suspended` and `disabled` are states the platform holds an organization in, `provisioning` and `failed` belong to its creation, and `deleting` means a teardown has been accepted.

## Related

- [`k0rdent_organizations`](../data-sources/organizations.md) data source: lists every one.
- [`k0rdent_project`](../resources/project.md) resource: takes an organization's id in `organization_id`.
